sloka: स तान् प्रचिच्छेद हि राक्षसेन्द्रश्छित्त्वा च ताँल्लक्ष्मणमाजघान ।शरेण कालाग्निसमप्रभेण स्वयम्भुदत्तेन ललाटदेशे ।। ६.५९.१०४ ।।।।
transliteration: sa tān praciccheda hi rākṣasendraśchittvā ca tām̐llakṣmaṇamājaghāna ।śareṇa kālāgnisamaprabheṇa svayambhudattena lalāṭadeśe ।। 6.59.104 ।।।।

translations.english: Lakshmana also, who is comparable to Mahendra, fitting his bow and arrows that shone like fire released sharp and pointed arrows to put an end to Rakshasa king.
